pages.text: $(li)Craft a $(item)Car Workbench$() and put it down.$(li)Craft the car's three parts: its $(thing)chassis$(), $(thing)body$() and $(thing)interior$() (see $(l:vehicles)Vehicles$(/l) for each car's).$(li)Craft an engine (a $(item)Car Engine$() for most cars) and four $(item)Tire$()s.

$(li)Build the car at the workbench (see $(l:getting_started/workbench)The Car Workbench$(/l)) and put it down.$(li)Cut a key: sneak and right-click the car with a $(item)Blank Key$() ($(l:driving/keys)Car Keys$(/l)).$(li)Fill it up at a pump ($(l:fuel/pumps)Gas and Diesel Pumps$(/l)) and drive off ($(l:driving/controls)Controls$(/l)).
Tires are made from dried kelp and black dye.
The engine is built round a BuildCraft Combustion Engine.
